summary: The hook blocks tool calls that would spend a paid Anthropic or OpenAI API key outside a paying customer's request, including tests, evals, demos and CI jobs.
doc: This hook denies a tool call that would spend a paid Anthropic or OpenAI API key. It blocks HTTP calls to spending endpoints such as messages, chat completions, responses, embeddings and batches, POST requests with a body to either API host, SDK spending methods run inline from a shell, and spending calls written into a test, fixture, eval, smoke, demo, CI, script or scheduled-job path. A billed token cannot be refunded, so the hook stops the call before it runs. GET /v1/models, reading an error body, editing a product's inference driver, the Gemini free tier, a model on localhost and a subscription CLI in print mode are allowed. To quote a spending command on purpose in a file, put it in a fenced code block, an inline backtick span, an indented block or a '>' blockquote. A Bash command or a fetched URL is never treated as a quotation.
